metric: DEVICE KERNEL DURATION [ns]; one fresh program per (config, variant); ttnn.generic_op
precision_contract: FIXED on every variant: fp32 partial/stat CBs, HiFi2, fp32_dest_acc_en=False, math_approx_mode=False. Never a lever.
baseline: flat == the op's CURRENT root chain, carried verbatim: D16 row-major gather + one per-row packer-accumulate (L1Accumulation::SeedFirst) fold call + D17 column-scoped raw-sfpi StatFinalize + D19 finalize-writes-cb_stat_handoff.
candidate: grid_k<K>_m<m> == K contiguous slot chunks x m row subsets, gatherer for (chunk j, row subset w) = slot j*(G/K)+w. (1,1)=flat via the generic path, (K,1)=slot tree, (1,m)=row split, (K,m)=combined.

focus_g8_ng8_br8_r32.geometry: (1,1,8192,1024) BLOCK_SHARDED shard [1024,128] grid (8,8) = 64 cores; G=8, num_groups=8, BLOCK_ROWS=8, 32 tile-rows/core -> 4 combine rounds

zones_flat_root_core.note: root chain 38384+8870 = 47254 ~= the 46519 ns wall: the zones ARE the wall, and only the 8 root cores pay while 7 members each block in writer_mcast_recv.

zones_grid_k1_m8.note: writer_mcast_recv collapses 42778 -> 4733: no member blocks behind a root any more.

extra_hop_accounting_per_round.verdict: the extra hop is 17% of the parallelism it buys -- it does NOT eat it.

sweep.columns: config -> {variant: ns}; flat absent == L1_OOM (the flat root's G*BLOCK_ROWS fp32 gather ring does not fit)

statement: m = min(BLOCK_ROWS, GROUP_SIZE)                       # spend gatherers on ROWS first, ALL of them
K_cap = GROUP_SIZE // m                               # a chunk must contain its m gatherers
K = smallest divisor of GROUP_SIZE >= sqrt(GROUP_SIZE); if K > K_cap, take the largest divisor <= K_cap
K = 1 if GROUP_SIZE - (GROUP_SIZE/K + K) < 2          # the tree must delete >= 2 fold tiles per row (kills GROUP_SIZE <= 4)
K = 1 if GROUP_SIZE <= 8 and num_blocks > 1           # at G <= 8 the tree deletes <= 2 tiles/row, less than the ~1 us/round the extra hop costs
rule.accuracy: optimal at 13 of the 15 measured (GROUP_SIZE, BLOCK_ROWS) cells; 2.8% off at g16 decode (picks K=4, best K=8) and 4% off at g32/BLOCK_ROWS=2 (picks K=8, best K=4). Never below 1.00x anywhere.

integration_facts.semaphores: the descriptor allocates mcast's two (ids 0,1) + gather (id 2) = 3 today. The RULE's row split needs a 4th (id 3: finished-rows-landed-in-the-mcast-buffer). A combined K>1 point needs a 5th (id 4: stage-2 forward arrivals). NUM_SEMAPHORES = 16 per core (tt_metal/impl/buffers/semaphore.hpp), so there is ample room.
integration_facts.l1: the gather ring goes from GROUP_SIZE*BLOCK_ROWS pages to (GROUP_SIZE/K)*ceil(BLOCK_ROWS/m). Focus: 352 kB -> 44 kB per core, i.e. 308 kB HANDED BACK. It also makes BLOCK_ROWS values the flat root cannot express at all (G=8/BR=32 needs 1408 kB, G=32/BR=32 needs 4480 kB) legal.
integration_facts.l1_does_not_buy_more_speed_directly: raising BLOCK_ROWS 8 -> 32 under (1,8) at G=8 measures 18748 -> 19001 ns, i.e. FLAT. The L1 win is worth 308 kB/core to the rest of the op, not extra combine speed.
integration_facts.unified_path_overhead: grid_k1_m1 (the generic path at the flat corner) is a reproducible 47161 vs 46436 = +1.6% (181 ns/round) on the focus, and up to +8% (222 ns) on the 2.6 us g4 decode combine. The bench keeps K and m COMPILE-TIME and already if-constexprs stage 2 and the stage-3 wait away; the residual is the row-split arithmetic, the per-subset ship loop and the gatherer-coord RT reads. A production spelling that if-constexprs the whole (K==1 && m==1) body back to the flat one pays 0.
integration_facts.flow_control: unchanged in kind: a remote sender is gated by the PREVIOUS round's stat multicast, which the root only sends after every stage-3 gatherer finalized, which requires each gatherer's compute to have drained that round's gather ring. Same argument the op already relies on for its single root.
integration_facts.no_self_signal: preserved. Every gatherer writes its own slot synchronously and waits for exactly M-1 / K-1 / w_eff-1 REMOTE incs; Semaphore::up is a non-atomic local RMW and is never used on a counter the core itself owns.
integration_facts.cb_row_final_caveat: the row-split writes finished stat tiles into the ROOT's cb_row_final at a row offset, relying on every core pushing the same page count per round so the local write pointer equals the root's. In the op cb_row_final is consumed by pass B, so the root must not let the buffer wrap before the workers' writes land -- the root's cb_reserve_back(rows) happens before its stage-3 wait, which orders it, but the integration must keep that order.

precision_menu.K==1_row_split: NUMERICALLY IDENTICAL to flat -- the per-row fold is still one GROUP_SIZE-long SeedFirst pack-accumulate, just on a different core. pcc and rel-RMS match flat to all printed digits in EVERY config measured (focus 0.999989 / 0.00320 both).
precision_menu.K>1_slot_tree: changes the fp32 summation ORDER (M-wide partial sums then a K-wide fold). rel-RMS moves by <= 0.0007 absolute (g32 decode 0.00389 -> 0.00509); pcc stays >= 0.999978. Still fp32 throughout -- the precision CONTRACT is untouched, only the association order.
precision_menu.gate: soft pcc gate 0.9995 / rel-RMS 0.04. Every one of the 134 measured variant-runs passes with pcc >= 0.999978 and rel-RMS <= 0.0054. No variant trades precision for speed.

how_to_rerun: then: python3 <this dir>/read_results.py <the printed ops_perf_results csv> [out.json]
